welcome: Hi! Ask me about shipping, returns, pricing, or support hours.

chunks.content:
# Acme Store — Customer FAQ

## Shipping
We ship within the US and EU. Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days. Express shipping (1–2 days) is available at checkout for $12.

Orders over $75 qualify for free standard shipping.

## Returns
You can return unused items within 30 days of delivery. Start a return from your order confirmation email or contact support@acme.store.

Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after we receive the item.

## Pricing
Starter plan: $0 — 1 chatbot, 3 docs, 50 answers/month.
Pro plan: $29/month — 5 chatbots, 20 docs each, 2,000 answers/month, no widget branding.

## Support hours
Live chat and email support: Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm ET. We respond to emails within one business day.
